items.description: This is a mash-up of Google Calendar, Google Maps with our church management software that tracks church events and locations of small groups that are meeting.

Lets a business share docs from their Microsoft SkyDrive over SMS via Twilio. Go to the app which is running on Windows Azure, set which SkyDrive account to use, and select a public file to share over SMS. Customers (incl. potential customers) can call the Twilio number associated with the #docs deployment and text link to get a link to whatever doc you're currently sharing (for deals, specials, marketing info, etc.) For the sample #docs deployment, call my Twilio number (415)599-2671, enter passcode 7392-3266, and message link.
Connected is a personal relationship manager that brings your contacts and conversations together from email, social networks, calendar and phone.
Fertility calculator that also integrates with Google Calendar.
A mashup of Blogger and Google Calendar. Embed links and summaries of blog posts in your calendar.
Golf course and syndicated golf news. Integrated Google Calendar lets you see upcoming events.
Takes data submitted with a Formstack form and creates corresponding event entries on a Google Calendar.
Create, update, and track your business plan with your entire team and export out a document version at any time.

You can use this tool to calculate travel mileage for any number of trips, fetching information from Google Maps. Better yet, if you have trips entered in Google Calendar, you can fetch those events towards calculating mileage.
Takes a BBC Programme search and converts the results in to iCal format for use in Google Calendar.
Backpack Dashboard Widget for Mac OS X 10.4.

A realtime classifieds service. Receive text alerts for job and business opportunities that are submitted by other users of the service. To respond, reply call by text message, and a call will be placed between the two parties.
AirportHotels.com is a free hotel comparison service for hotels near 28 UK airports including Heathrow, Stansted, Gatwick, Manchester Airport and more. Integrates with the sletoh.com API.
track, graph, tweak, find trends in your habits and share on facebook, twitter, etc. more 'input' APIs to follow
This mashup helps locate safety shelters in India. With Tropical Cyclone Phailin closing in on land many people will be looking to find safety.
Scholarship Database uses Indeed and Google maps to create a job posting aggregate.
A freely browsable database of crimes reported in Chicago overlaid onto Google Maps.
Randomly selected missing person profiles from National Center for Missing And Exploited Children feeds. Just glance at them once in a while and report sighting to authorities.
Auto-translates as you type. Set the language, or let it detect the language for you.
An advertising network for Twitter. It lets Twitter users earn money while tweeting and gives advertisers access to the ever-growing Twitter community.
Find the altitude of any place with a point-and-click interface.

This real-time vehicle tracker takes position reports sent a server and plots them as pushpins. The map refreshes at about the same interval as the position reports coming in. Right-click two pushpins and get some distance, speed, and time info.
Tweedly uses the Twilio API and infochimps to keep subscribers informed (via SMS) of their Twitter influence ranking.
Lets you instantly search the Italian Play.me music catalogue. Preview a track and if you are a subscriber, listen and download it on www.playme.it.
Real-time photos from Twitter on top of Google Maps.
Quintura.com is a visual-based search engine for web discovery and browsing of any web content, including tests, images, videos, and products.

A job search engine and web mashup that incorporates Google Maps to see the location of an employer, LinkedIn to see which of your contacts works at the job location, and Payscale to see current salary analysis by job category.
Lost your phone? Punch in your number and we'll call it for you.
Mashes up MLS home listings with bank-owned property records to flag active listings as bank-owned. Allows the bargain-hunter buyer to identify homes for sale owned by a bank.
Random generator of music-video playlists based on the specified mood: (happy, sad, angry, relaxed) and genre. Great for finding new bands.
The PickRent Mapping Widget shows rental listings from you, the property manager in an interactive way. Just customize the widget to your liking and then embed code in your own site or blog.
The eMiniMall advertising banners are built on top of the shopping.com APIs.

Notwilfications is a Google Chrome Extension that shows you when a call comes in and allows you to either ignore it or send it to voicemail, without ever having to pick up your phone to know who's calling.
Puts all things about Downtown Fredericksburg, VA, on a map.

You are at a scenic overlook and see distant summits. Find out what they are with HeyWhatsThat which provides panoramic sketches and the names of peaks. Browse panoramas that others have requested and generate your own.
This useful mashup helps you find good quality, free online course material from schools worldwide including Harvard and MIT. Both video and audio content available.
Tall Tweets lets you write longer messages on Twitter by transforming the tweet into an image.
Geospeaker is a web application providing a virtual loudspeaker to communicate with people around you
Headline stories and gossip on soccer teams in the four English football leagues.
Find and rate hotties from Google Streetview.
Create online video mixtapes to share with friends. Search for artists or songs on YouTube. Drag results into your list to create your own mixtape.
A ghost report community where you can post your true ghost encounter. Find and view other ghost encounters using the Google Maps map. Find similar cases around the world or in your town.
Find and rate the best Bloody Mary in your neighborhood.
Siftlinks monitors your Twitter friend stream and extracts the tweets that contain URL's, creating an easy to consume RSS feed for you to subscribe to and peruse at your leisure.
ErrorStack.com is a new online service designed to help developers manage and analyze their error data.
Free tool to measure the power and authority of a Twitter user.
ZMS is a free SMS gateway with a retro 8BIT user interface. ZMS enables any iOS device to send and receive free SMS text messages to any cell phone.
Search for a rest area anywhere in the US. Information includes services at the rest area.

Cognotix is an easy way for businesses of all sizes to contact with their customers via telephone or the Internet. Using an intutive web-based management console, you can quickly create and deploy feedback response interfaces to your customers in the way that's most convenient for them to respond. Each survey is automatically assigned a unique survey key that customers use to access your survey via a branded web page or a toll-free telephone number.
View the lines and stops of the metro system in Naples, Italy.
Loku is an application that displays local neighborhood maps and lets users explore what is happening nearby. It displays news stories and videos, events and deals.

Near Here is a travel-ready, lead-generating iPhone app that helps you find, research and contact leads. The D&B Direct API Near Here web app extends the power of the Hoover's Near Here mobile application to your enterprise sales tools.
Tracks and graphs Amazon price history. Allows user to be emailed when the price hits a desired point.

Android Application Social Searcher - Facebook Search Without Logging in. Make your keyword search around Facebook and find out what people are talking about now. Application supports all languages for searching. Social Searcher allows you to open links from search results in your Android web browser, sort search results by date/time, sort search results by number of â€œlikesâ€ and filter by country.
Find a dentist in your area with this Twilio powered video directory. Provides other relevant information to users.
Dynamic content surrounding Google map that changes with location. Returns local search results from Google and Yahoo.
BART station maps, schedules, timetables, and other details in a convenient Google Map
Frugalytics is a comparison shopping and deal finder that aggregates deals from around the web.
Morces is a mobile web platform that put businesses on mobile.

Social Interest is a system for connecting families with a range of publicly funded health and human service programs in California. Communities can use it to screen people for programs such as Medi-Cal, Healthy Families, local health insurance programs.

The app allows users to search for rental apartments and houses right on Facebook. A combination of Google Map and Facebook API mashup allows users to search for rentals, share postings with friends, message them or simply chat to ask for opinion.
Worldwide vacation rental listings direct from owners.
Real estate search for France.
Bookafy is an online scheduling and appointment tracking web app. This mashup makes use of the Zendesk Core API for ticket tracking and management.
A small Google Maps Mashup displays the weather forecast and weather-tweets in a nice, simple style.
ARSights is a Web-based tool for visualizing Google Earth 3D models using augmented reality.
An open source free Java Point of Sale system for restaurants. To ensure fast development and scalability, Floreant POS used the Flickr API and Google Custom Search engine.
iMetro helps you find your way in the public transportation systems in over 250 cities, with maps in New York, London, Paris, Madrid, Berlin, Amsterdam and more.
A community to search, rate, and review local restaurants or find a new place to eat.
Area based plots of US Census Bureau data.

Field Engineer (FE) android mobile app provides its provider community with easy access to telecom & networking jobs globally. The app allows engineers to apply, accept, manage, complete and get paid for a job.
Togfrog is videos with maps covering a wide selection of adventure travel activities that can inspire and guide travelers going on adventures all over the world.
Salesforce SMS is a Visual Force page to send an SMS from salesforce.com
A look at the 25 most unsafe cities in America.
Map based data visualization tool driven by Pentaho open source business intelligence tools and Google Maps.
Site developed to share walking and running routes.

A better search for Flickr. Uses special processing to find for more than just what you search for. Searching for music will not just look for that word but also for concert, band, ipod and other related concepts.
See locations of the venues for the 2006 events with good links to details from the official Olympics site. From Remo Madella.

Discover upcoming events and stuff to do in a nice and simple interface based on Google Maps. Search for events, narrow down with category, place or date and sort your search by relevance, date, title, popularity or venue name. Mapping Events is powered by Eventful API, Google Maps API, Google AJAX Search API, WorldIP API, Yahoo YQL and Yahoo YUI.

An Instagram x Google Maps mashup and a community-driven wild food and medicine plant identification and social mapping service. Provide a platform to locate sources of free food and medicine plants (native or not) living in the landscape, sharing locations and related knowledge through social media interaction.

EtsyEspy is a buyer's tool for browsing the vast collection of listings available on Etsy. Select a filter, then EtsyEpsy will display listings in a Photo gallery. Runs either in your browser window or in full screen mode. Moving your cursor over hidden listings will bring them to the top. If there's a particular listing of interest, click on it and the listing's Etsy page loads.
The first video guide for hotels. Nicely integrated search and Google Maps. Uses Amazon S3 for video storage.
Mashup of Joomla, Amazon eCommerce, and NY Times Best Sellers.
Find your dining places in Croatia: restaurants, tTaverns, pizzerias, and other spots
Notify member agents of new customers that are seeking real estate agents in their area. Full buyer/seller details are provided over the phone for deciding whether to work with the prospect.
Our Sun Sign, Mind, Body and Yoga are all interconnected. Your Zodiac Sign, Health and Yoga is a Faceook app which helps to explore Health and Yoga based on Zodiac signs.
Twitter 411 service lets you build your own information system, uses Twitter as a transport.
An restaurant mashup based on Google maps. The locator allows visitors to search restaurants by keyword or category. It is also possible to search for restaurants located in a given neighborhood.
Foamee helps track who you owe beers or coffees to, and vice versa.
Send messages to Twitter with voice. This is a speech to text service that allows Twitter users to speak their Tweets from their phone.
GetControl is a mobile payment application that provides businesses a way to measure and manage their online payments. This application is built for mobile, and uses Stripe API.
USA webcams via Google maps. Limited amount of content.
Noodler makes vehicle comparison fun! See similarities and differences at a glance. Data from Edmunds.com, the highly reputable research site.
This Service is a mashup service using twitter and google maps apis. It displays a users twitter status on the globe.
First cruise site that plots cruise routes in Google Maps and Google Earth.
Maps and descriptions of skateparks for skateboarding and biking in europe. User contributed content.
Site developed to help dirt bike riders find places and people to enjoy their sport.
Search Flickr for geotagged photos and then plot them on a Google Map. Nice nested map-within-a-map.
A site specializing in local news and local business listings.
Add your pets to your Facebook profile page.
See the location of elaborate Christmas lights displays. Readers can add comments and vote for favorites.
100 Destinations aggregations photos and quotes from sites like Twitter and allows users to experience what I city is like from an insiders perspective.
Monitor top selling video games by console using Amazon sales data. Add lists to your iGoogle home page.

TapTravel is a mobile application that allows users to search for and book for flights. TapTravel is available in all major mobile platforms. The Allmyles API has been integrated into this application.

By combining the Motel 6 property database with a list of attractions and cross-indexing them in Google Maps, the Attraction Finder functions as a searchable trip planner. Also, make a reservation near a desired vacation spot.

Display your Google Latitude location and location history. Guest and public access options control who can view your location. Dead Zone keeps your location from being displayed when you are within X miles of the location you specify.

Display your Etsy profile, shop or listings in a signature banner image which you can use in forums, emails, websites, blogs, etc.. This dynamic signature will update automatically if you change your profile, shop info or if you add new items to your shop.
CNN Money list of the top 10 most expensive colleges in the United States. Not necessarily the ones you would expect.
Displays Portland TriMet MAX light rail lines and stations on Google Maps.
Best cities for singles with respect to many parameters, including cost of living, career prospects, nightlife and more. Map data based on rankings compiled by Forbes.
Uses Google Maps and Twitter APIs to show where your Twitter followers are coming from and what they're interested in.
Allows users to preview files in their Box.net accounts using Increo Preview.

Mapinterest links Pinterest, Instagram and YouTube with Facebook Places. You follow people on Twitter, on Facebook you follow your friends, on Pinterest you follow topics and on Mapinterest you follow places.

Qabic allows you to effortlessly handle Q&A for your talks/panels by allowing your audience to submit and vote on questions throughout the event. This allows the best questions to be easily accesible both during and after your talk/panel.
Connected to Us creates a communication system using the hardware your team members and customers already own.
DARAO is a YouTube viewer for lazybones. DARAO plays YouTube featured movies automatically without clicks.
A way to explore all life forms in a taxonomic way. Useful for students, scientists and curious people. Flickr and GBIF (gbif.org) APIs.
Tour Nanaimo British Columbia with photos plotted on a Google Map.

CouponFollow tracks coupon codes that have been tweeted by Twitter users in real-time, and organizes them for bargain shoppers to use. Coupon popularity is tracked by the total number of Tweets. Members can easily retweet codes they like via Twitter.
Dolphin Music Artists is a directory of musicians and the musical instruments they play. See which guitars and amps are used by the artists.
Listmania cc is a collection of book lists and film lists. Listmania cc will improve the experience of browsing and reviewing all these lists.
Deals, discounts and offers worldwide, shown on a map.
Mashup of sporting events with weather conditions and forecasts on a Google Map.
Dictionary for iPhone or iPad.
Get your favorite maps on the small display screen of your smartphones.
Crowdcentre is a crowdsourced call centre run by volunteers around the globe with good intention of helping people know more about what they're looking for.

Doctor Who - unlike Star Trek which always used the same rock for its location filming - was surprisingly varied in its choice of quarries. This mashup shows where they are all and includes a kml for Google Earth.
A recommendation link list generator extracted from site owner's bookmarks archived in del.icio.us. Entire generation process is via client side JavaScript.
Google Maps holiday trivia map showing cities and towns in USA: named Turkey, or that claim to be the turkey capital of the US or world, or are named Plymouth, or are named Cranberry.

Music followers is an twitter and idiomag mashup. It helps twitter users find other people to follow based on their music tastes. It uses the twitter search api and the idiomag api and its run on google app engine.

Tracegps.com lets you search and share your favorite outdoor trail by importing and exporting GPS data and Google mapping them. Use it to send files of your walk, bike ride or running trail or find a new hike or city tour nearby.
